reference_policy: Local screenshots attached; Figma inaccessible, not imported; Apple screenshot used for alignment only.

directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality PhaseZero desktop UI design with clear hierarchy, strong typography, purposeful whitespace. Full frame app content only, straight-on, target dimensions 1440 x 1024. Current date anchor 2026-11-02; omit dates, quota percentages and live metrics unless marked example. Language Brazilian Portuguese. This is a design proposal for approval, not an implemented product. Add very small external editorial label 'CONCEITO VISUAL · DADOS ILUSTRATIVOS' unobtrusively at bottom.
Input image roles: screenshot of current PhaseZero is product structure grounding; ICO contact sheet is source identity reference only (some icons in it are wrong: NEVER use the Drive glyph for Docs, generic G for Google apps, or same suite icon for Word/Excel/PowerPoint); screenshot of Apple official badge guidelines is optical alignment/clear-space/typographic precision mood reference ONLY. Do not copy Apple page, logos or badge wording into the app.
Hard constraints: Existing native Qt Linux control center, Windows native counterpart and Steam Deck are eventual targets. Preserve existing app name and recognizable PZ/shield identity. Reuse existing catalog and explicit scope, no invented router, no fake certification, no Apple/Google store availability or payment/integration badges. Never conflate installation with authenticated session, quota, grant or proven readiness. Use local-looking third-party logos only where grounded in attached sources; preserve colors and proportions, no recolored third-party brandmarks. PhaseZero-owned app/folder/utility icons may be original, refined family artwork.
Focus screen, not feature inventory: one hero use case, one clear contextual primary action and at most two supporting actions. Native body 15-16px, secondary 13-14px, no microscopic columns. Two fonts maximum. Align and group on a base surface, then lightweight dividers; do not default to nested bordered cards or card walls. Shadows only subtle. No emoji or text symbols masquerading as icons. Pictograms share 24px grid and consistent optical stroke. Separate functional monochrome navigation pictograms from premium dimensional app icons. No blur dependence, no neon glow, no gauges, fake health metrics or marketing banner. Fit without clipped text. Show clear selected row and visible keyboard-focus treatment. Color must not be the sole label for status.
Direction name: Obsidiana. Dark violet editorial control center, native desktop sensibility. Palette: background #14151A, surface #1E2028, strong text #F3F4F7, supporting text #B0B5C3, action #7854E8 with white, focus #B39AF5, amber attention. Reduce purple surface saturation relative to current screenshot; charcoal base and a restrained violet selection.
Layout: tall 224px left navigation with PhaseZero shield/PZ at top, readable grouped existing destinations, selected 'Aplicativos'. Respect original navigation IDs/groups; lower long list can naturally scroll and must not fill the canvas with 22 entries. Main content header 'Aplicativos', one contextual search 'Buscar aplicativos e ferramentas'. A single 5-row catalog occupies about 650px width, 80px rows, generous spacing, one selected row 'ai-memory' and description 'Memória compartilhada dos agentes'. Other rows '.NET SDK', '9Router', 'Ananicy Cpp', 'Audacity' follow actual supplied screenshot, with concise human descriptions. Use own semantic fallback pictograms (memory layers, code, route, speed, waveform) whenever no original logo is supplied; do not invent logos for these third parties. Each row has text label 'Não verificado', no fabricated installed status.
Right contextual inspector about 300px wide: prominent neutral memory pictogram with beautiful optical geometry, name 'ai-memory', short explanation, label 'Estado ainda não verificado', one primary action 'Verificar estado', secondary text action 'Ver detalhes'. Data panel flat, not nested cards; no huge information grid.
Under the list in the same product surface show compact existing managed-shortcut area 'Atalhos PhaseZero', only four original high-quality PhaseZero-family icons with readable labels 'Contas', 'Entrada', 'Terminal', 'Teclado'. These are utility launchers already present on host, not a new service. Master icons have common 56px softly beveled violet tile, crisp inset white pictogram, tactile precision, very restrained material, each glyph distinctive. This small area demonstrates how premium family propagates to installed derivatives. Keep functional left nav icons flat 20px. Overall typography confident, rounded corners 10-14px max, one-pixel dividers, no excessive borders. Bottom quiet operation strip 'Nenhuma operação em andamento'. This must feel like an immediately understandable mature premium system utility, not a marketing dashboard. Render one cohesive screen, not a montage of alternatives.
references: Official Apple guideline screenshot in local review cache

Direction name: Porcelana. Light mineral native desktop UI: warm off-white #F5F6FA base, pure white #FFFFFF surface, ink #20232D, supporting text #5E6677, deep violet #6540D8 with white text, focus #6540D8. Soft neutral dividers, precise 1px edge, generous calm spacing. No washed-out low contrast. Preserve PZ/shield identity. Compact 216px left navigation, fit original groups naturally with scroll, active 'Contas e conexões'. Header 'Contas e conexões', subtitle 'Uma identidade, seus canais de acesso'. Hide real account identities; only fictional/default label 'Principal', no email or personal nicknames.
Focused central content is account identity and channel selection, not metric cards. Main account row features premium existing-style PhaseZero Codex account icon, simple polished violet tile with the recognizable layered/rosette terminal mark as grounded in attached actual accounts screenshot. Name 'Codex Principal', quiet neutral status 'Sessão não verificada'. Explain 'Abra o aplicativo para entrar ou retomar sua sessão.' One strong primary button 'Abrir Desktop', supporting actions 'Abrir CLI' and 'Navegador' as quiet text or secondary buttons. A small 'Adicionar conta' control in header is subordinate.
Make three distinct channel rows below: 'Desktop' — 'Aplicativo com sessão própria'; 'CLI' — 'Terminal de desenvolvimento'; 'Web experimental' — 'Login e ferramentas verificados separadamente'. Each has crisp consistent 24px channel icon: monitor, terminal, globe. Row 'Web experimental' has amber outline label 'Experimental', no paid-plan claims. Keep description line readable. No simultaneous connection, hidden permissions, quota data or false green ready label.
Bottom supporting section 'Atalhos da conta': three beautiful matching launcher icons about72px each on white, one for 'Desktop', one for 'CLI', one for 'Web'. Same violet account color and core identity on all, tiny clear surface pictogram external to core mark plus text label; differences must remain obvious in grayscale. App icon material subtle ceramic/glass-like sheen but no excessive 3D. This visual specimen explains account family differentiation without redrawing a third-party official logo. Secondary action 'Organizar atalhos' as simple text.
A short info note 'Instalação, sessão e ferramentas têm verificações separadas.' ties directly to the current product truth. No wallet UI or secret key fields; those stay existing flows offscreen. Quiet bottom operation strip 'Nenhuma operação em andamento'. Structure predominantly one flat surface with whitespace and simple dividers, no nested cards, no feature inventory. Show one visible keyboard focus ring. One cohesive premium realistic screen at 1440x1024.

Direction name: Grafite. Graphite-and-mint premium utility with an expressive but restrained native desktop identity. Base #10161C, surface #1A242D, text #EAF1F3, secondary #A6B7C5, accent #67D5BC with dark #0E1A17 text, focus #67D5BC. Mostly flat matte black/graphite; mint only for primary action, selection underline and small identity details. Own PhaseZero family app icons use graphite rounded tiles with mint inset symbols, soft bevel precision and almost no gloss. Functional symbols flat monochrome, not purple.
Structure meaningfully different: same existing PhaseZero native app, 208px left navigation retaining actual group names and labels, active 'Desenvolvimento'. Spacious top header 'Preparar desenvolvimento', short subtitle 'Escolha um objetivo. Revise antes de aplicar.' A focused two-column task composition: left 680px primary form, right 320px flat contextual plan summary (no card inside card). Core form: label 'Objetivo', chosen option 'Web JavaScript / TypeScript'; label 'Editor (opcional)', value 'Escolher depois'. Form fields are readable, 48px high, with clear chevrons and focus ring on one field. Below short concise note 'Node.js e pnpm para seu projeto.' No personal hardcoded paths, no fabricated files, no live verified system status.
One primary action 'Revisar plano e preparar' in mint; supporting actions 'Validar ambiente' and 'Abrir ferramenta' look secondary and clearly disabled until appropriate stage, with short explanation 'Disponíveis após a preparação'. Right plan summary heading 'Antes de aplicar', row with package icon 'Node.js e pnpm', line 'Editor opcional', neutral small state 'Plano ainda não revisado'. Explicit caption 'Revise dependências e permissões no próximo passo.' No package installation size or progress invented.
Bottom supporting section on same flat main surface 'Utilitários PhaseZero'. Exactly six consistent original app-family icons in one row, no chunky cards: 'Entrada', 'Touch', 'Microfone', 'Terminal', 'Teclado', 'Ditado'. Each about64px icon with label and plenty spacing. Distinct glyphs: Entrada = game controller with recovery arrow (not sign-in arrow), Touch = fingertip touching screen, Microfone = mic with repair detail, Terminal = terminal prompt, Teclado = keyboard, Ditado = voice waveform with cursor. These are existing host-managed shortcuts; no new services. Most screen weight must remain the primary preparation task; icon area is a restrained supporting specimen to approve family styling. Show quiet bottom 'Nenhuma operação em andamento'. This is an industrial, precise, calm premium design with stronger readability and technical clarity, not a gaming HUD, no gradient wallpaper and no extra dashboard metrics. One cohesive screen, 1440 x 1024.
